title: Unity & Vive Trackers - Guide for Set Up with Hand Engine
summary: This knowledgebase article will show you how to set up your Vive Trackers to track the position and rotation of StretchSense Studio gloves in space. These instructions will also work for other Vive tracker models not listed here that have a mode to emulate SteamVR-compatible trackers (e.g. Vive Wrist trackers connected to a Vive Focus 3 / Vive XR Elite or Vive Ultimate trackers from the PCVR beta).
